name: Product shot list writer
why: Writes a shot list with a reason for each shot, the same one-job-per-shot rule as the shot-list-and-shoot-brief skill.

name: Product photo shoot planner
why: Builds a style sheet so every picture in a shoot matches; check its frames against the truth-to-product rule in this kit.

name: A full product photoshoot from your phone photos
why: Plans a phone shoot with a light set-up per shot, a companion to the home-studio-setup prompt.

name: Product photo set maker
why: Checks AI product photos against the real product and redoes failed frames, the same check as step 4 of the AI check skill.

name: Product image spec writer
why: Writes a sourced truth sheet for a product before any image work, so edits never change how it looks.

name: Product page image checker
why: Gives a pass or fail per image before upload; pair it with the dated channel spec sheet from this kit.

name: Store image prep checker
why: Covers resizing, renaming, alt text and gallery order, the delivery steps of the channel image skill.

name: Image upscale checker
why: Checks an upscale for changes to the image, useful when AI output is smaller than a channel's suggested size.

name: Product gallery doubt review and image builder
why: Reviews a gallery against shopper doubts, like the listing-image-audit prompt.

name: Turn real photos into a product page gallery
why: Plans about eight gallery images that each answer one shopper question, from real photos.

name: Turn a clothing flat lay into marketplace-ready photos
why: Turns a garment photo into marketplace images with a rules check; keep a real photo as the main image.

name: Make matching photos for a product sheet and check them
why: Makes consistent photos across a product list and checks marketplace rules, as in the catalogue-image-refresh workflow.

name: AI image and video fix rule writer
why: Turns feedback on AI images into fix rules, so the same product distortion is caught every time.
